sourceChecks.text: So Jehoiakim slept with his fathers, and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his place.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. His mother’s name was Nehushta the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: and Jehoiachin the king of Judah went out to the king of Babylon—he, his mother, his servants, his princes, and his officers; and the king of Babylon captured him in the eighth year of his reign.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: He carried away Jehoiachin to Babylon, with the king’s mother, the king’s wives, his officers, and the chief men of the land. He carried them into captivity from Jerusalem to Babylon.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文と必要な前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: In the thirty-seventh year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, Evilmerodach king of Babylon, in the year that he began to reign, released Jehoiachin king of Judah out of prison,
